items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: I think probably the first clarinetist I was impressed by was Pee Wee Russell... I began to become more interested in Pee Wee Russell... I went for many years imitating Pee Wee

ctx.x: I think probably the first clarinetist I was impressed by was Pee Wee Russell.
Did you hear Pee Wee in Boston? No, not at that age.
